record.original_question: For the stochastic scheduling model on an unreliable machine governed by the coupled equations d/dt p0(x,t) + d/dx p0(x,t) = -(lambda(x)+mu(x)) p0(x,t) and d/dt p1(x,t) + d/dx p1(x,t) = -eta(x) p1(x,t), with boundary conditions p0(0,t) = delta(t) + integral from 0 to infinity of p1(x,t) eta(x) dx and p1(0,t) = integral from 0 to infinity of p0(x,t) lambda(x) dx, and initial data p0(x,0) = delta(x), p1(x,0) = 0, determine the explicit time-dependent solution in the general non-constant case lambda(x), mu(x), eta(x). Equivalently, determine the Laplace inverse transforms of the formulas for p1-hat(x,s) and p0-hat(x,s) so that the full time-domain solution can be written down.

evidence.quote: But we can not obtain the Laplace inverse transform, that is to say, we could not give the explicit expression of the time-dependent solution for general case.

If we can determine the Laplace inverse transform of (3.13) and (3.14), then we can get the time-dependent solution of the equation system (1.1)-(1.5). But, until today we have not discovered an efficient method to resolve this problem.

artifact.category_tag: First-order hyperbolic PDE systems with boundary coupling
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda,\mu,\eta:[0,\infty)\to[0,\infty)$ be measurable, locally bounded, non-negative functions (the "failure rate", "repair-related rate", and "service-completion rate", respectively). Consider the system of first-order linear hyperbolic PDEs for unknowns $p_0(x,t),p_1(x,t)$ on $(x,t)\in[0,\infty)\times[0,\infty)$:

$$\frac{\partial p_0}{\partial t}(x,t)+\frac{\partial p_0}{\partial x}(x,t)=-\bigl(\lambda(x)+\mu(x)\bigr)p_0(x,t),$$
$$\frac{\partial p_1}{\partial t}(x,t)+\frac{\partial p_1}{\partial x}(x,t)=-\eta(x)p_1(x,t),$$

subject to the (distributional) boundary conditions at $x=0$:
$$p_0(0,t)=\delta(t)+\int_0^\infty p_1(x,t)\,\eta(x)\,dx,\qquad p_1(0,t)=\int_0^\infty p_0(x,t)\,\lambda(x)\,dx,$$
and initial conditions
$$p_0(x,0)=\delta(x),\qquad p_1(x,0)=0.$$

Taking the Laplace transform in $t$, $\hat p_i(x,s)=\int_0^\infty e^{-st}p_i(x,t)\,dt$, one obtains explicit closed-form expressions

$$\hat p_0(x,s)=\hat p_0(0,s)\,e^{-sx-\int_0^x(\lambda(\tau)+\mu(\tau))\,d\tau},\qquad \hat p_1(x,s)=\hat p_1(0,s)\,e^{-sx-\int_0^x\eta(\tau)\,d\tau},$$

with $\hat p_0(0,s),\hat p_1(0,s)$ determined by the boundary equations.

Problem: For general non-constant rate functions $\lambda(x),\mu(x),\eta(x)$, determine the inverse Laplace transforms of $\hat p_0(x,s)$ and $\hat p_1(x,s)$ in closed form, thereby giving an explicit expression for the time-dependent solution $(p_0(x,t),p_1(x,t))$ of the system above.
artifact.status_search_result: No published closed-form inverse Laplace transform giving the explicit time-dependent solution for general (non-constant) rates $\lambda,\mu,\eta$ appears to be available; the standard literature on such reliability/queueing supplementary-variable models analyzes well-posedness, asymptotic behavior, and steady-state solutions, while explicit time-dependent solutions are known only in special (e.g. constant-rate) cases. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Stochastic analysis of an unreliable machine model
status_evidence.snippet: Studies asymptotic behavior and well-posedness; notes inability to invert the Laplace transform in the general case.
status_evidence.claim: Explicit time-dependent solution for general non-constant rates is not given.
